lines.text: Saul becomes king at thirty, keeps two thousand men at Michmash, and Jonathan attacks the Philistine outpost at Geba.
The Philistines camp at Michmash with three thousand chariots, and the frightened men of Israel hide in caves and cisterns.
After waiting seven days for Samuel, Saul offers the burnt offering himself, and Samuel arrives just as he finishes.
Samuel tells Saul he acted foolishly, so the LORD has appointed a prophet just like Samuel to rule His people.

wrong_details.true: a man after His own heart

lines.text: Saul counts about two thousand men, and on the day of battle only Saul and Jonathan have a sword or spear.
